Q1.en: Since \(\frac{1}{x^2+6} = \frac{1}{31}\), the denominators are equal: \(x^2 + 6 = 31\), so \(x^2 = 25\) and \(x = \pm 5\), which is the choice \(\pm 5\).

Q2.en: \(\sqrt{2}\) is irrational, and the product of a non-zero rational number (here 2) and an irrational number is always irrational. So \(2\sqrt{2}\) is an irrational number.
Q2.hi: \(\sqrt{2}\) अपरिमेय है, और किसी शून्येतर परिमेय संख्या (यहाँ 2) तथा अपरिमेय संख्या का गुणनफल सदैव अपरिमेय होता है। अतः \(2\sqrt{2}\) एक अपरिमेय संख्या है।

Q3.en: With \(\cos\theta = \frac{12}{13}\), take the adjacent side as 12 and the hypotenuse as 13 in a right triangle. The opposite side is \(\sqrt{13^2 - 12^2} = \sqrt{169 - 144} = \sqrt{25} = 5\). So \(\cot\theta = \frac{\text{adjacent side}}{\text{opposite side}} = \frac{12}{5}\), which is the choice \(\frac{12}{5}\).
Q3.hi: \(\cos\theta = \frac{12}{13}\) है, अतः समकोण त्रिभुज में आधार 12 तथा कर्ण 13 लेने पर लम्ब \(= \sqrt{13^2 - 12^2} = \sqrt{169 - 144} = \sqrt{25} = 5\)। अतः \(\cot\theta\) = आधार / लम्ब \(= \frac{12}{5}\)। सही विकल्प \(\frac{12}{5}\) है।

Q4.en: For equal roots the discriminant must be zero. Here \(a = 2\), \(b = -8\), so \(b^2 - 4ac = (-8)^2 - 4(2)(c) = 64 - 8c = 0\), which gives \(c = 8\).

Q5.en: In similar triangles \(\Delta ABC \sim \Delta DEF\) the corresponding angles are equal, so \(\angle B = \angle E = 56^\circ\). By the angle sum property, \(\angle C = 180^\circ - 79^\circ - 56^\circ = 45^\circ\).
Q5.hi: समरूप त्रिभुजों \(\Delta ABC \sim \Delta DEF\) में संगत कोण बराबर होते हैं, अतः \(\angle B = \angle E = 56^\circ\)। त्रिभुज के कोणों के योग गुण से \(\angle C = 180^\circ - 79^\circ - 56^\circ = 45^\circ\)।

Q6.en: Since \(\cot\alpha = \frac{1}{\tan\alpha}\), the condition \(\tan\alpha = \frac{1}{\tan\alpha}\) gives \(\tan^2\alpha = 1\), so \(\tan\alpha = 1\) for an acute angle and \(\alpha = 45^\circ\).
Q6.hi: चूँकि \(\cot\alpha = \frac{1}{\tan\alpha}\), अतः \(\tan\alpha = \frac{1}{\tan\alpha}\) से \(\tan^2\alpha = 1\), अर्थात् न्यून कोण के लिए \(\tan\alpha = 1\) और \(\alpha = 45^\circ\)।

Q7.en: Two cubes have \(12\) faces, each of area \(b^2\). When they are joined, the two touching faces are hidden, so \(10\) faces remain and the surface area is \(10b^2\) m\(^2\). (Check: the solid is a cuboid \(2b \times b \times b\), with surface area \(2(2b \cdot b + b \cdot b + b \cdot 2b) = 10b^2\).)
Q7.hi: दो घनों के कुल \(12\) फलक होते हैं, प्रत्येक का क्षेत्रफल \(b^2\) है। मिलाने पर संलग्न दो फलक छिप जाते हैं, अतः \(10\) फलक बचते हैं और पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल \(10b^2\) मी\(^2\) है। (जाँच: बना ठोस \(2b \times b \times b\) का घनाभ है, जिसका पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल \(2(2b \cdot b + b \cdot b + b \cdot 2b) = 10b^2\) है।)

Q8.en:
The equation is written in the variable \(t\), but the nature of its roots depends only on the coefficients \(a\), \(b\), \(c\), so the discriminant \(b^2 - 4ac\) applies unchanged.
(i) A quadratic equation has at most two roots, so this statement is false.
(ii) If \(b^2 - 4ac > 0\) the roots are real and distinct: true.
(iii) If \(b^2 - 4ac = 0\) the roots are real and equal: true.
(iv) If \(b^2 - 4ac < 0\) there are no real roots: true.
So statements (ii), (iii) and (iv) are correct.
Q8.hi:
समीकरण चर \(t\) में लिखा है, परन्तु मूलों की प्रकृति केवल गुणांकों \(a\), \(b\), \(c\) पर निर्भर करती है, अतः विविक्तकर \(b^2 - 4ac\) यहाँ भी वैसे ही लागू होता है।
(i) द्विघात समीकरण के अधिक से अधिक दो मूल होते हैं, अतः यह कथन असत्य है।
(ii) यदि \(b^2 - 4ac > 0\) तो मूल वास्तविक और भिन्न होते हैं: सत्य।
(iii) यदि \(b^2 - 4ac = 0\) तो मूल वास्तविक और बराबर होते हैं: सत्य।
(iv) यदि \(b^2 - 4ac < 0\) तो कोई वास्तविक मूल नहीं होता: सत्य।
अतः कथन (ii), (iii) तथा (iv) सही हैं।

Q9.en: By the distance formula: from \((4, 0)\) to \((4, 4)\) is \(4\); from \((0, 4)\) to \((4, 4)\) is \(4\); from \((4, 0)\) to \((0, 4)\) is \(\sqrt{16 + 16} = 4\sqrt{2}\). Two sides are equal, and \(4^2 + 4^2 = 32 = (4\sqrt{2})^2\), so the triangle is an isosceles right triangle.

Q10.en: The modal class is the class with the highest frequency. The highest frequency in the table is 5, for the class 12-22, so the modal class is 12-22.
Q10.hi: बहुलक वर्ग वह वर्ग होता है जिसकी बारंबारता सबसे अधिक हो। सारणी में सबसे अधिक बारंबारता 5 है, जो वर्ग 12-22 की है। अतः बहुलक वर्ग 12-22 है।

Q11.en: An event that is certain to occur is a sure event, and the probability of a sure event is 1.
Q11.hi: जो घटना अवश्य घटित होती है वह निश्चित घटना कहलाती है, और निश्चित घटना की प्रायिकता 1 होती है।

Q12.en: Here \(n = 4 + 6 + 10 + 6 + 4 = 30\), so \(\frac{n}{2} = 15\). The cumulative frequencies are 4, 10, 20, 26, 30. The first cumulative frequency greater than 15 is 20, which belongs to the class 12-18. So the median class is 12-18.

Q13.en: Let the numbers be \(x\) and \(y\) with \(x + y = 10\) and \(x - y = 4\). Adding, \(2x = 14\), so \(x = 7\) and \(y = 3\). The numbers are 7 and 3.

Q15.en: Here the first term is \(a = 20\) and the common difference is \(d = 17 - 20 = -3\). So \(a_{13} = a + 12d = 20 + 12(-3) = 20 - 36 = -16\).

Q17.en:
Divide the numerator and the denominator by \(\sin\theta\):
\(\frac{b\sin\theta - a\cos\theta}{b\sin\theta + a\cos\theta} = \frac{b - a\cot\theta}{b + a\cot\theta} = \frac{b - a \cdot \frac{b}{a}}{b + a \cdot \frac{b}{a}} = \frac{b - b}{b + b} = 0\).
So the value is 0.
Q17.hi:
अंश और हर दोनों को \(\sin\theta\) से भाग देने पर:
\(\frac{b\sin\theta - a\cos\theta}{b\sin\theta + a\cos\theta} = \frac{b - a\cot\theta}{b + a\cot\theta} = \frac{b - a \cdot \frac{b}{a}}{b + a \cdot \frac{b}{a}} = \frac{b - b}{b + b} = 0\)।
अतः मान 0 है।

Q18.en: \((\sec A + \tan A)(1 - \sin A) = \left(\frac{1}{\cos A} + \frac{\sin A}{\cos A}\right)(1 - \sin A) = \frac{(1 + \sin A)(1 - \sin A)}{\cos A} = \frac{1 - \sin^2 A}{\cos A} = \frac{\cos^2 A}{\cos A} = \cos A\).
Q18.hi: \((\sec A + \tan A)(1 - \sin A) = \left(\frac{1}{\cos A} + \frac{\sin A}{\cos A}\right)(1 - \sin A) = \frac{(1 + \sin A)(1 - \sin A)}{\cos A} = \frac{1 - \sin^2 A}{\cos A} = \frac{\cos^2 A}{\cos A} = \cos A\)।

Q19.en: \((\sqrt{7} - \sqrt{5})(\sqrt{7} + \sqrt{5}) = (\sqrt{7})^2 - (\sqrt{5})^2 = 7 - 5 = 2\), which is rational. The others are irrational: \(\sqrt{3}/\sqrt{5} = \frac{\sqrt{15}}{5}\), \(\sqrt{2} \times \sqrt{7} = \sqrt{14}\) and \(\sqrt{12} = 2\sqrt{3}\).

Q20.en: The radius through the point of contact is perpendicular to the tangent, so the radius, the tangent and the line to the centre form a right triangle with hypotenuse 5 cm. Length of tangent \(= \sqrt{5^2 - 3^2} = \sqrt{16} = 4\) cm.
Q20.hi: स्पर्श बिन्दु से जाने वाली त्रिज्या स्पर्श रेखा पर लम्ब होती है, अतः त्रिज्या, स्पर्श रेखा और केन्द्र को मिलाने वाली रेखा एक समकोण त्रिभुज बनाती हैं जिसका कर्ण 5 सेमी है। स्पर्श रेखा की लम्बाई \(= \sqrt{5^2 - 3^2} = \sqrt{16} = 4\) सेमी।

B1a.en:
Suppose, on the contrary, that \(6 - \sqrt{2}\) is rational. Then \(6 - \sqrt{2} = \frac{p}{q}\), where \(p\) and \(q\) are integers and \(q \neq 0\).
Then \(\sqrt{2} = 6 - \frac{p}{q} = \frac{6q - p}{q}\).
Since \(p\) and \(q\) are integers, \(\frac{6q - p}{q}\) is rational, so \(\sqrt{2}\) would be rational.
But \(\sqrt{2}\) is irrational. This contradiction arises from the assumption that \(6 - \sqrt{2}\) is rational. Hence \(6 - \sqrt{2}\) is irrational.
B1a.hi:
माना कि \(6 - \sqrt{2}\) एक परिमेय संख्या है। तब \(6 - \sqrt{2} = \frac{p}{q}\), जहाँ \(p\) और \(q\) पूर्णांक हैं तथा \(q \neq 0\)।
अतः \(\sqrt{2} = 6 - \frac{p}{q} = \frac{6q - p}{q}\)।
चूँकि \(p\) और \(q\) पूर्णांक हैं, इसलिए \(\frac{6q - p}{q}\) परिमेय है, अर्थात् \(\sqrt{2}\) परिमेय होगा।
परन्तु \(\sqrt{2}\) अपरिमेय है। यह विरोधाभास इस कल्पना के कारण है कि \(6 - \sqrt{2}\) परिमेय है। अतः \(6 - \sqrt{2}\) अपरिमेय है।

B1b.en:
A point on the \(x\)-axis has \(y\)-coordinate 0, so let it be \(P(x, 0)\). Since it is equidistant from \((2, -5)\) and \((-2, 9)\), the squares of the distances are equal:
\((x - 2)^2 + (0 + 5)^2 = (x + 2)^2 + (0 - 9)^2\)
\(x^2 - 4x + 4 + 25 = x^2 + 4x + 4 + 81\)
\(-8x = 56\), so \(x = -7\).
The required point is \((-7, 0)\).

B1c.en:
Multiply the numerator and the denominator under the root by \((1 + \sin x)\):
LHS \(= \sqrt{\frac{(1 + \sin x)^2}{(1 - \sin x)(1 + \sin x)}} = \sqrt{\frac{(1 + \sin x)^2}{1 - \sin^2 x}} = \sqrt{\frac{(1 + \sin x)^2}{\cos^2 x}}\)
\(= \frac{1 + \sin x}{\cos x}\) (for acute \(x\), \(\cos x > 0\))
\(= \frac{1}{\cos x} + \frac{\sin x}{\cos x} = \sec x + \tan x =\) RHS.
Hence proved.
B1c.hi:
मूल के अन्दर अंश और हर दोनों को \((1 + \sin x)\) से गुणा करने पर:
बायाँ पक्ष \(= \sqrt{\frac{(1 + \sin x)^2}{(1 - \sin x)(1 + \sin x)}} = \sqrt{\frac{(1 + \sin x)^2}{1 - \sin^2 x}} = \sqrt{\frac{(1 + \sin x)^2}{\cos^2 x}}\)
\(= \frac{1 + \sin x}{\cos x}\) (न्यून कोण \(x\) के लिए \(\cos x > 0\))
\(= \frac{1}{\cos x} + \frac{\sin x}{\cos x} = \sec x + \tan x =\) दायाँ पक्ष।
इति सिद्धम्।

B1d.en:
Here \(r = 21\) cm and \(\theta = 60^\circ\).
Area of the minor sector \(= \frac{\theta}{360^\circ} \times \pi r^2 = \frac{60}{360} \times \frac{22}{7} \times 21 \times 21 = 231\) cm\(^2\).
The triangle formed by the chord and the two radii has two sides equal to 21 cm and the included angle \(60^\circ\), so it is equilateral. Its area \(= \frac{\sqrt{3}}{4} \times 21^2 = \frac{441\sqrt{3}}{4}\) cm\(^2\) \(\approx 190.95\) cm\(^2\).
Area of the minor segment \(=\) area of sector \(-\) area of triangle \(= \left(231 - \frac{441\sqrt{3}}{4}\right)\) cm\(^2\) \(\approx 231 - 190.95 = 40.05\) cm\(^2\).
B1d.hi:
यहाँ \(r = 21\) सेमी तथा \(\theta = 60^\circ\)।
लघु त्रिज्यखंड का क्षेत्रफल \(= \frac{\theta}{360^\circ} \times \pi r^2 = \frac{60}{360} \times \frac{22}{7} \times 21 \times 21 = 231\) सेमी\(^2\)।
जीवा तथा दोनों त्रिज्याओं से बने त्रिभुज की दो भुजाएँ 21 सेमी हैं और उनके बीच का कोण \(60^\circ\) है, अतः यह समबाहु त्रिभुज है। इसका क्षेत्रफल \(= \frac{\sqrt{3}}{4} \times 21^2 = \frac{441\sqrt{3}}{4}\) सेमी\(^2\) \(\approx 190.95\) सेमी\(^2\)।
लघु वृत्तखंड का क्षेत्रफल \(=\) त्रिज्यखंड का क्षेत्रफल \(-\) त्रिभुज का क्षेत्रफल \(= \left(231 - \frac{441\sqrt{3}}{4}\right)\) सेमी\(^2\) \(\approx 231 - 190.95 = 40.05\) सेमी\(^2\)।

B1e.en:
Total number of marbles \(= 8 + 4 + 5 = 17\).
(i) There are 4 white marbles, so \(P(\text{white}) = \frac{4}{17}\).
(ii) Marbles that are not green \(= 17 - 5 = 12\), so \(P(\text{not green}) = \frac{12}{17}\).
B1e.hi:
कंचों की कुल संख्या \(= 8 + 4 + 5 = 17\)।
(i) सफेद कंचे 4 हैं, अतः सफेद कंचा निकलने की प्रायिकता \(= \frac{4}{17}\)।
(ii) जो कंचे हरे नहीं हैं उनकी संख्या \(= 17 - 5 = 12\), अतः हरा कंचा न निकलने की प्रायिकता \(= \frac{12}{17}\)।

B1f.en:
By the section formula, the point dividing the join of \((x_1, y_1) = (3, 4)\) and \((x_2, y_2) = (-2, -1)\) in the ratio \(m_1 : m_2 = 3 : 2\) is
\(x = \frac{m_1 x_2 + m_2 x_1}{m_1 + m_2} = \frac{3(-2) + 2(3)}{3 + 2} = \frac{-6 + 6}{5} = 0\),
\(y = \frac{m_1 y_2 + m_2 y_1}{m_1 + m_2} = \frac{3(-1) + 2(4)}{3 + 2} = \frac{-3 + 8}{5} = 1\).
The required point is \((0, 1)\).

B2a.en:
Let O be the common centre, and let the chord PQ of the larger circle touch the smaller circle at the point M.
Then OM is a radius of the smaller circle and PQ is a tangent to it at M, so \(OM \perp PQ\), with \(OM = 3\) cm. Also OP is a radius of the larger circle, so \(OP = 5\) cm.
In right \(\Delta OMP\): \(PM = \sqrt{OP^2 - OM^2} = \sqrt{5^2 - 3^2} = \sqrt{25 - 9} = \sqrt{16} = 4\) cm.
The perpendicular from the centre to a chord bisects the chord, so \(PQ = 2 \times PM = 2 \times 4 = 8\) cm.
The length of the chord is 8 cm.
B2a.hi:
माना O दोनों वृत्तों का उभयनिष्ठ केन्द्र है तथा बड़े वृत्त की जीवा PQ छोटे वृत्त को बिन्दु M पर स्पर्श करती है।
तब OM छोटे वृत्त की त्रिज्या है और PQ बिन्दु M पर उसकी स्पर्श रेखा है, अतः \(OM \perp PQ\) तथा \(OM = 3\) सेमी। साथ ही OP बड़े वृत्त की त्रिज्या है, अतः \(OP = 5\) सेमी।
समकोण \(\Delta OMP\) में: \(PM = \sqrt{OP^2 - OM^2} = \sqrt{5^2 - 3^2} = \sqrt{25 - 9} = \sqrt{16} = 4\) सेमी।
केन्द्र से जीवा पर डाला गया लम्ब जीवा को समद्विभाजित करता है, अतः \(PQ = 2 \times PM = 2 \times 4 = 8\) सेमी।
जीवा की लम्बाई 8 सेमी है।

B2b.en:
Let the two consecutive positive integers be \(x\) and \(x + 1\). Then
\(x^2 + (x + 1)^2 = 545\)
\(2x^2 + 2x + 1 = 545\)
\(2x^2 + 2x - 544 = 0\), i.e. \(x^2 + x - 272 = 0\)
\(x^2 + 17x - 16x - 272 = 0\)
\((x + 17)(x - 16) = 0\), so \(x = 16\) or \(x = -17\).
The integers are positive, so \(x = 16\). The integers are 16 and 17. (Check: \(16^2 + 17^2 = 256 + 289 = 545\).)

B2d.en:
Make the cumulative frequency table:

| Class interval | Frequency | Cumulative frequency |
|---|---|---|
| 0-10 | 5 | 5 |
| 10-20 | 25 | 30 |
| 20-30 | 25 | 55 |
| 30-40 | \(p\) | \(55 + p\) |
| 40-50 | 7 | \(62 + p\) |

So \(n = 62 + p\). The median 24 lies in the class 20-30, so it is the median class, with \(l = 20\), \(cf = 30\), \(f = 25\), \(h = 10\).
Median \(= l + \left(\frac{\frac{n}{2} - cf}{f}\right) \times h\)
\(24 = 20 + \frac{\frac{62 + p}{2} - 30}{25} \times 10\)
\(4 = \frac{2}{5}\left(\frac{62 + p}{2} - 30\right)\)
\(\frac{62 + p}{2} - 30 = 10\), so \(\frac{62 + p}{2} = 40\) and \(62 + p = 80\).
Hence \(p = 18\). (Check: \(n = 80\), \(\frac{n}{2} = 40\) falls in 20-30, as assumed.)

B2e.en:
Total number of balls \(= 7 + 3 + 5 = 15\).
(i) \(P(\text{black}) = \frac{7}{15}\).
(ii) \(P(\text{red}) = \frac{3}{15} = \frac{1}{5}\).
(iii) Balls that are not white \(= 15 - 5 = 10\), so \(P(\text{not white}) = \frac{10}{15} = \frac{2}{3}\).

B2f.en:
**Given:** In \(\Delta PQR\), a line parallel to QR meets PQ at M and PR at N, so \(MN \parallel QR\).
**To prove:** \(\frac{PM}{MQ} = \frac{PN}{NR}\).
**Construction:** Join QN and RM. Draw \(NX \perp PQ\) and \(MY \perp PR\).
**Proof:** \(\text{ar}(\Delta PMN) = \frac{1}{2} \times PM \times NX\) and \(\text{ar}(\Delta QMN) = \frac{1}{2} \times MQ \times NX\), so
\(\frac{\text{ar}(\Delta PMN)}{\text{ar}(\Delta QMN)} = \frac{PM}{MQ}\) ...(1)
Similarly \(\text{ar}(\Delta PMN) = \frac{1}{2} \times PN \times MY\) and \(\text{ar}(\Delta RNM) = \frac{1}{2} \times NR \times MY\), so
\(\frac{\text{ar}(\Delta PMN)}{\text{ar}(\Delta RNM)} = \frac{PN}{NR}\) ...(2)
\(\Delta QMN\) and \(\Delta RNM\) are on the same base MN and between the same parallels MN and QR, so
\(\text{ar}(\Delta QMN) = \text{ar}(\Delta RNM)\) ...(3)
From (1), (2) and (3), \(\frac{PM}{MQ} = \frac{PN}{NR}\).
Hence the line divides the other two sides in the same ratio. Proved.
B2f.hi:
**दिया है:** \(\Delta PQR\) में भुजा QR के समान्तर एक रेखा PQ को M पर तथा PR को N पर प्रतिच्छेद करती है, अर्थात् \(MN \parallel QR\)।
**सिद्ध करना है:** \(\frac{PM}{MQ} = \frac{PN}{NR}\)।
**रचना:** QN तथा RM को मिलाइए। \(NX \perp PQ\) तथा \(MY \perp PR\) खींचिए।
**उपपत्ति:** \(\text{ar}(\Delta PMN) = \frac{1}{2} \times PM \times NX\) तथा \(\text{ar}(\Delta QMN) = \frac{1}{2} \times MQ \times NX\), अतः
\(\frac{\text{ar}(\Delta PMN)}{\text{ar}(\Delta QMN)} = \frac{PM}{MQ}\) ...(1)
इसी प्रकार \(\text{ar}(\Delta PMN) = \frac{1}{2} \times PN \times MY\) तथा \(\text{ar}(\Delta RNM) = \frac{1}{2} \times NR \times MY\), अतः
\(\frac{\text{ar}(\Delta PMN)}{\text{ar}(\Delta RNM)} = \frac{PN}{NR}\) ...(2)
\(\Delta QMN\) तथा \(\Delta RNM\) एक ही आधार MN पर तथा समान्तर रेखाओं MN और QR के बीच स्थित हैं, अतः
\(\text{ar}(\Delta QMN) = \text{ar}(\Delta RNM)\) ...(3)
(1), (2) तथा (3) से, \(\frac{PM}{MQ} = \frac{PN}{NR}\)।
अतः रेखा अन्य दो भुजाओं को समान अनुपात में विभाजित करती है। इति सिद्धम्।

B3a.en:
Let the first term be \(a\) and the common difference \(d\). Using \(S_n = \frac{n}{2}[2a + (n - 1)d]\):
\(S_7 = \frac{7}{2}(2a + 6d) = 7(a + 3d) = 49\), so \(a + 3d = 7\) ...(1)
\(S_{17} = \frac{17}{2}(2a + 16d) = 17(a + 8d) = 289\), so \(a + 8d = 17\) ...(2)
Subtracting (1) from (2): \(5d = 10\), so \(d = 2\), and then \(a = 7 - 6 = 1\).
So \(S_n = \frac{n}{2}[2(1) + (n - 1)2] = \frac{n}{2}(2n) = n^2\).
The sum of the first \(n\) terms is \(n^2\).

B3b.en:
Let the base be \(x\) m. Then the altitude is \((x - 7)\) m and the hypotenuse is 13 m. By Pythagoras theorem:
\(x^2 + (x - 7)^2 = 13^2\)
\(x^2 + x^2 - 14x + 49 = 169\)
\(2x^2 - 14x - 120 = 0\), i.e. \(x^2 - 7x - 60 = 0\)
\(x^2 - 12x + 5x - 60 = 0\)
\((x - 12)(x + 5) = 0\), so \(x = 12\) or \(x = -5\).
A length cannot be negative, so \(x = 12\). The base is 12 m and the altitude is \(12 - 7 = 5\) m. (Check: \(12^2 + 5^2 = 144 + 25 = 169 = 13^2\).)

B4a.en:
Divide the numerator and the denominator of the LHS by \(\cos\theta\):
LHS \(= \frac{\tan\theta - 1 + \sec\theta}{\tan\theta + 1 - \sec\theta} = \frac{(\tan\theta + \sec\theta) - 1}{\tan\theta - \sec\theta + 1}\)
Using \(1 = \sec^2\theta - \tan^2\theta = (\sec\theta - \tan\theta)(\sec\theta + \tan\theta)\) in the numerator:
\(= \frac{(\tan\theta + \sec\theta) - (\sec\theta - \tan\theta)(\sec\theta + \tan\theta)}{\tan\theta - \sec\theta + 1}\)
\(= \frac{(\tan\theta + \sec\theta)(1 - \sec\theta + \tan\theta)}{\tan\theta - \sec\theta + 1}\)
\(= \tan\theta + \sec\theta\)
\(= \frac{(\sec\theta + \tan\theta)(\sec\theta - \tan\theta)}{\sec\theta - \tan\theta} = \frac{\sec^2\theta - \tan^2\theta}{\sec\theta - \tan\theta} = \frac{1}{\sec\theta - \tan\theta} =\) RHS.
Hence proved.
B4a.hi:
बाएँ पक्ष के अंश और हर दोनों को \(\cos\theta\) से भाग देने पर:
बायाँ पक्ष \(= \frac{\tan\theta - 1 + \sec\theta}{\tan\theta + 1 - \sec\theta} = \frac{(\tan\theta + \sec\theta) - 1}{\tan\theta - \sec\theta + 1}\)
अंश में \(1 = \sec^2\theta - \tan^2\theta = (\sec\theta - \tan\theta)(\sec\theta + \tan\theta)\) रखने पर:
\(= \frac{(\tan\theta + \sec\theta) - (\sec\theta - \tan\theta)(\sec\theta + \tan\theta)}{\tan\theta - \sec\theta + 1}\)
\(= \frac{(\tan\theta + \sec\theta)(1 - \sec\theta + \tan\theta)}{\tan\theta - \sec\theta + 1}\)
\(= \tan\theta + \sec\theta\)
\(= \frac{(\sec\theta + \tan\theta)(\sec\theta - \tan\theta)}{\sec\theta - \tan\theta} = \frac{\sec^2\theta - \tan^2\theta}{\sec\theta - \tan\theta} = \frac{1}{\sec\theta - \tan\theta} =\) दायाँ पक्ष।
इति सिद्धम्।

B4b.en:
Let PQ be the tower of height \(h\) m with foot Q on the ground. When the sun's elevation is \(60^\circ\), let the shadow be QR \(= x\) m; when it is \(30^\circ\), the shadow is QS \(= (x + 50)\) m.
In right \(\Delta PQR\): \(\tan 60^\circ = \frac{h}{x}\), so \(\sqrt{3} = \frac{h}{x}\) and \(x = \frac{h}{\sqrt{3}}\) ...(1)
In right \(\Delta PQS\): \(\tan 30^\circ = \frac{h}{x + 50}\), so \(\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}} = \frac{h}{x + 50}\) and \(x + 50 = \sqrt{3}h\) ...(2)
Subtracting (1) from (2): \(50 = \sqrt{3}h - \frac{h}{\sqrt{3}} = \frac{3h - h}{\sqrt{3}} = \frac{2h}{\sqrt{3}}\)
\(h = \frac{50\sqrt{3}}{2} = 25\sqrt{3}\) m \(\approx 25 \times 1.732 = 43.3\) m.
The height of the tower is \(25\sqrt{3}\) m, about 43.3 m.
B4b.hi:
माना PQ मीनार है जिसकी ऊँचाई \(h\) मी है तथा Q उसका पाद है। जब सूर्य का उन्नयन कोण \(60^\circ\) है तब छाया QR \(= x\) मी है, और जब \(30^\circ\) है तब छाया QS \(= (x + 50)\) मी है।
समकोण \(\Delta PQR\) में: \(\tan 60^\circ = \frac{h}{x}\), अतः \(\sqrt{3} = \frac{h}{x}\) और \(x = \frac{h}{\sqrt{3}}\) ...(1)
समकोण \(\Delta PQS\) में: \(\tan 30^\circ = \frac{h}{x + 50}\), अतः \(\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}} = \frac{h}{x + 50}\) और \(x + 50 = \sqrt{3}h\) ...(2)
(2) में से (1) घटाने पर: \(50 = \sqrt{3}h - \frac{h}{\sqrt{3}} = \frac{3h - h}{\sqrt{3}} = \frac{2h}{\sqrt{3}}\)
\(h = \frac{50\sqrt{3}}{2} = 25\sqrt{3}\) मी \(\approx 25 \times 1.732 = 43.3\) मी।
मीनार की ऊँचाई \(25\sqrt{3}\) मी, अर्थात् लगभग 43.3 मी है।

B5a.en:
The vessel is a sphere with a cylindrical neck, so the water it holds is the volume of the sphere plus the volume of the cylinder (taking \(\pi = 3.14\)).
Sphere: diameter 8.5 cm, so radius \(R = 4.25\) cm.
Volume of sphere \(= \frac{4}{3}\pi R^3 = \frac{4}{3} \times 3.14 \times (4.25)^3 = \frac{4}{3} \times 3.14 \times 76.765625 \approx 321.39\) cm\(^3\).
Cylinder: diameter 2 cm, so radius \(r = 1\) cm, and height \(h = 8\) cm.
Volume of cylinder \(= \pi r^2 h = 3.14 \times 1^2 \times 8 = 25.12\) cm\(^3\).
Volume of water \(\approx 321.39 + 25.12 = 346.51\) cm\(^3\).
(With \(\pi = \frac{22}{7}\) the volume is about \(321.68 + 25.14 = 346.82\) cm\(^3\).)
B5a.hi:
बर्तन एक गोला है जिसकी गर्दन बेलनाकार है, अतः इसमें भरे जा सकने वाले पानी का आयतन = गोले का आयतन + बेलन का आयतन (\(\pi = 3.14\) लेने पर)।
गोला: व्यास 8.5 सेमी, अतः त्रिज्या \(R = 4.25\) सेमी।
गोले का आयतन \(= \frac{4}{3}\pi R^3 = \frac{4}{3} \times 3.14 \times (4.25)^3 = \frac{4}{3} \times 3.14 \times 76.765625 \approx 321.39\) सेमी\(^3\)।
बेलन: व्यास 2 सेमी, अतः त्रिज्या \(r = 1\) सेमी तथा ऊँचाई \(h = 8\) सेमी।
बेलन का आयतन \(= \pi r^2 h = 3.14 \times 1^2 \times 8 = 25.12\) सेमी\(^3\)।
पानी का आयतन \(\approx 321.39 + 25.12 = 346.51\) सेमी\(^3\)।
(\(\pi = \frac{22}{7}\) लेने पर आयतन लगभग \(321.68 + 25.14 = 346.82\) सेमी\(^3\) आता है।)

B5b.en:
The hemisphere rests on a face of the cube, so its diameter cannot be more than the side of the cube. The greatest diameter of the hemisphere is 14 cm, so its radius is \(r = 7\) cm.
Surface area of the solid \(=\) surface area of the cube \(-\) area of the base of the hemisphere \(+\) curved surface area of the hemisphere
\(= 6a^2 - \pi r^2 + 2\pi r^2 = 6a^2 + \pi r^2\)
\(= 6 \times 14^2 + \frac{22}{7} \times 7^2 = 6 \times 196 + 154 = 1176 + 154 = 1330\) cm\(^2\).
The greatest diameter is 14 cm and the surface area of the solid is 1330 cm\(^2\).
B5b.hi:
अर्धगोला घन के एक फलक पर रखा है, अतः उसका व्यास घन की भुजा से अधिक नहीं हो सकता। अर्धगोले का अधिकतम व्यास 14 सेमी है, अतः त्रिज्या \(r = 7\) सेमी।
ठोस का पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल \(=\) घन का पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल \(-\) अर्धगोले के आधार का क्षेत्रफल \(+\) अर्धगोले का वक्र पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल
\(= 6a^2 - \pi r^2 + 2\pi r^2 = 6a^2 + \pi r^2\)
\(= 6 \times 14^2 + \frac{22}{7} \times 7^2 = 6 \times 196 + 154 = 1176 + 154 = 1330\) सेमी\(^2\)।
अर्धगोले का अधिकतम व्यास 14 सेमी तथा ठोस का पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल 1330 सेमी\(^2\) है।

doubts.Q17: As printed (b sin - a cos over b sin + a cos, with cot = b/a) the value is 0, an option; the familiar textbook form (a sin - b cos)/(a sin + b cos) gives (a^2 - b^2)/(a^2 + b^2), also an option, so the setter may have meant that one.
